meta.name: Of Love And Shadows
meta.description: Irene is a magazine editor living under the shadow of the Pinochet dictatorship in Chile. Francisco is a handsome photographer and he comes to Irene for a job. As a sympathizer with the underground resistance movement, Francisco opens her eyes and her heart to the atrocities being committed by the state.
meta.slogan: Surrounded by danger, they'll risk everything for freedom!
